messages:
Sophie Nguyen: Quick pulse — who's up for a two-week lunchtime fitness challenge? Options: 1) 20-min bouldering sesh Mon/Wed/Fri in the boulder room; 2) 3x/week 3mi run loop at 12:30; 3) desk mobility + 10min hangboard. Vote with emoji: :climbing_man: = boulder, :runner: = run, :person_in_lotus_position: = mobility

Carlos Rojas: :climbing_man: I'm in for bouldering — can only do Tue/Thu mornings though, but happy to join alternate days if people prefer evenings.

Jamie Lin: :runner: prefer run. 3mi okay but can we do a relaxed pace group so folks who are new can keep up?

Ava Patel: :person_in_lotus_position: mobility only for me. I've got a niggling knee, so low-impact pls.

Devon Park: I'm down for boulder or run, leaning boulder. @Carlos Rojas we can swap days. Also down for a mini leaderboard? :trophy:

Sophie Nguyen: Looks like boulder has a lead but a mixed plan might work. Proposal: boulder Mon/Wed (beginner-friendly), group run Fri at 12:30. Who can make Fri run? react :thumbsup: if yes.

Jamie Lin: :thumbsup: works for me. I'll help set a gentle pace and bring a couple of beginner interval plans.

Carlos Rojas: :thumbsup: can do Fri. I'll also bring shoes if someone needs loaners.

Ava Patel: I'll join the Fri run as a mobility cooldown. Thanks for the beginner option on boulder — appreciate it.

GymBot: Reminder: reserve the boulder room via #office-bookings and add the Fri run to the company calendar. Quick links: https://calendar.company/redwood/run-club and /book boulder-room.

Sophie Nguyen: I'll spin up the calendar invites and ping the people who've reacted. Small prize idea: most sessions attended over two weeks gets a chalk bag + best-photo bragging rights. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Devon Park: Love it. Anyone want to tack on a 20-pullup microchallenge mid-lunch week1? low-barrier, scale as needed.

Ava Patel: Can we add some beginner holds and a short intro for new climbers? I'm new to bouldering and would feel better with a demo.

Sophie Nguyen: Absolutely — we'll pair experienced climbers with new folks and do a 5-min intro before the first session. Meeting point: lobby at 12:20. See y'all there!
